footer.about: EduBridge connects learners with vetted instructors for live cohort classes and one-on-one sessions, from professional exams to university courses.
footer.teachBody: Run cohorts or one-on-one sessions, set your hourly rate and get paid through the platform.

hero.body: Prepare for professional exams, keep up with university courses or master a specific topic. Join a scheduled cohort or book a private session at a time that suits you.

how.body: Every training on EduBridge is delivered live by a vetted instructor. Pick the format that fits how you learn best.
how.cohortBody: Join a group on a fixed schedule with a set price per seat. Enrol before the deadline while seats last.
how.oneBody: Pick an instructor and a time that works for you. You are only charged once the instructor accepts.
how.recordingsBody: Rewatch sessions and download the materials your instructor shares.
how.feedbackBody: Get clear notes on strengths, areas to improve and next steps.

categories.body: Whether you're sitting a professional exam, keeping up with a university module or picking up a new skill, start with the category that fits.
categories.specificTopicHint: Focused skills, from Python to public speaking

cta.body: Run cohorts or one-on-one sessions, set your own hourly rate and get paid through EduBridge.

instructor.title: Set up your teaching profile

profile.name: Full name

catalog.name: Name
catalog.descriptionHint: Shown to learners when they filter the catalogue. Optional.

trainings.title: Trainings
trainings.intro: Everything in the catalogue. Drafts and archived trainings are hidden from learners.
trainings.emptyBody: Create your first training. It stays a draft until you publish it.
trainings.noMatchesBody: Try a different search or clear the filters.

editor.newIntro: Save it as a draft first. You can publish once the checklist is complete.
editor.summaryHint: One line for catalogue cards and search results.
editor.descriptionHint: What learners will be able to do, who it's for and how it runs. At least 80 characters to publish.
editor.modalityHint: Cohort: a group with a fixed schedule. One-on-one: learners book an instructor.
editor.modalityLocked: Locked after publishing, because learners have seen how it's taught.
editor.metadataHint: Required details must be filled in before publishing.

editor.noInstructors: No instructors yet. Add at least one before publishing.

editor.pricingHint: Learners pay the first that applies: this training's own price, then the instructor's rate, then the standard price.

editor.overrideHint: Replaces the standard price and any instructor rates.

editor.archivedNote: Hidden from the catalogue. Learners already enrolled keep access.

done.publish: Published. It's now in the catalogue.
done.unpublish: Moved back to draft and hidden from the catalogue.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.intro: Standard prices for each format and category. Trainings and instructors can override them.

cohorts.title: Cohorts
cohorts.intro: Groups of learners taking a training together on a fixed schedule. Learners can enrol once a cohort is open.
cohorts.emptyBody: Create a cohort under a cohort training, then open it so learners can enrol.

impersonate.reasonHint: For example, the support request you're looking into.

settings.title: Platform settings
settings.intro: Money and policy rules that apply across the platform. Every change is saved as a new version and recorded in the audit log.

settings.instructorCancelBody: The learner didn't cause it, so they usually get everything back.
